text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of deaths by cause in the United States since 1900
Share of all deaths in each group of causes, based on the underlying cause listed on death certificates. “All other
causes” includes everything else, such as chronic lung disease, Alzheimer’s disease, kidney disease, other

tspan.tspan: Before 1933, the data covers only the states that registered deaths.
